reason: Approved within typography, spacing and interaction-state scope. The encoded samples show connected, unclipped Arabic headings, a consistent dark/cream/gold hierarchy, clearly separated feature rows, protected captions and an uncluttered price/CTA hold. The product and app are visibly demonstrated. This is a visual/UI approval, not certification of the unresolved perceptual audio requirements.

evidence.inspection: Personally inspected via view_image: ten encoded samples from 0.00 to 29.70 seconds. Opening premise, product reveal, lists, real app screens and final CTA have clear hierarchy.

Personally inspected via view_image: sampled transition sequences near 2.08, 6.5, 10.8, 14.35, 17.05, 20.05 and 25.5 seconds. Captions remain on a separate stable layer; heading fades avoid Arabic being visibly cut by the sampled wipes. This is sample inspection, not continuous playback.
Personally inspected at original 1080x1920. Large Arabic heading, book title and caption are legible; character and book do not cover the caption.
Personally inspected at original resolution. Three feature rows have clear numbering, baseline spacing and dividers, with no apparent glyph clipping or collision.
Personally inspected at original resolution. Recipe quantity 1.5, macro values and supporting callout visibly communicate a changed portion. Caption is separated from the app frame.
Personally inspected at original resolution. 15.99 SAR, action phrase and store URL are clearly ordered; no cursor/loading overlay or caption obscures the CTA.

Inspected recorded caption bounds: all 14 boxes at y=1460 with height 121.046875; widest spans x=101.90625 to 898.109375. Reports CTA settled by 26.35 seconds, leaving 3.45 seconds. Reviewed verify-source.py assertions supporting the bounds and seek-state checks.
Inspected CSS/source: Lalezar headings, Noto Arabic body and 51px bold captions; caption gutters left 80/right 160; no interactive behavior is implied for the encoded CTA.
Personally inspected screenshot: native video controls and responsive Arabic player layout visible without apparent horizontal overflow.

Source includes native controls, named download links and focus-visible outlines. Recorded tests report play/pause, scene seeks and three downloads at 320/390/1440px with no overflow or runtime errors; I did not independently run these interactions.

Recorded checks report zero layout/runtime errors, 33/33 sampled contrast checks, 1080x1920 at 60/1 fps and no decode warnings. One duplicate media-discovery warning remains; no visible defect identified in inspected encoded samples.

strengths: Caption blocks preserve Arabic shaping and remain distinct from product imagery.
Feature lists and the 15.99 SAR closing hierarchy are clear at inspected resolution.
Actual app values and an explicit 1.5 portion callout give the demonstration a readable state change.
Final CTA is clean and held, with a visible destination URL.

issues.detail: App microcopy, calculator disclaimers and some cover fine print will become small on a narrow phone. The main benefit text, portion callout, captions and price remain substantially larger; do not claim every pixel of the source app is equally readable.

The portion callout overlays part of the lower app action area at 22.775 seconds, while preserving the portion input, macro values and main narrative. This is acceptable for a demonstration rather than a full interaction tutorial.

limitations: No human listening capability: natural voice quality, intelligibility and perfect music removal are unverified. This limits approval to my assigned visual/UI domain.
Inspected stills, source and recorded test evidence; did not claim to watch continuous video or independently exercise the live player.
Caption safe margins are visible in this encoded composition; no actual TikTok overlay/device matrix was inspected.
No baseline visual comparison was performed, so the degree of improvement over the previous version is not numerically established.
non_applicable_criteria: Store checkout, app-wide interaction design, conversion performance, legal compliance and clinical nutrition validity are outside this ad typography/layout review.
Hover/pressed states inside the encoded video are not applicable; keyboard focus is relevant to the downloadable player and is defined in its source.
